cues.en: This will be a short video because I just need to clarify a term that sounds a little bit weird and
cues.zh: 這支很短，只需要釐清一個聽起來有點怪，甚至，

cues.en: spooky, but it's actually pretty mundane in the context of calculus, and that word is transcendental.
cues.zh: 神祕的術語，但在微積分裡其實很普通，就是 transcendental，超越。

cues.en: Now, you've probably heard this word in other contexts, maybe in horror movies or fiction books.
cues.zh: 你可能在其他場合聽過，例如恐怖電影或小說。

cues.en: And well, here's what happens when you Google the word transcendental.
cues.zh: Google 搜尋 transcendental，就會看到這些。

cues.en: It doesn't look very mathematical, but actually in the context of math, transcendental has a completely different meaning from any of this stuff that you see here.
cues.zh: 看起來不太像數學，但在數學裡，它的意思和這裡看到的完全不同。

cues.en: And I actually started writing out the definition, but then I looked it up on Wikipedia, and I was pretty happy with the definition on Wikipedia and how they phrased it.
cues.zh: 我原本開始寫定義，後來查維基百科，覺得定義和表達方式很好。

cues.en: So I just took a screenshot here.
cues.zh: 所以直接截圖。

cues.en: Basically, a transcendental function is a function that cannot be expressed by combining a finite number of terms algebraically.
cues.zh: 基本上，超越函數是無法用有限項的代數組合表示的函數。

cues.en: So the algebraic terms are adding and subtracting and multiplying and so on.
cues.zh: 代數運算，就是加、減、乘等。

cues.en: And so the idea is that transcendental functions just cannot be obtained through algebra.
cues.zh: 所以超越函數無法透過代數得到。

cues.en: They cannot be expressed through algebraic operations.
cues.zh: 不能用代數運算表示。

cues.en: In other words, transcendental functions transcend algebra.
cues.zh: 換句話說，超越函數超越了代數。

cues.en: Now, that may sound esoteric or, I don't know, weird and celestial, but they're actually normal functions that are used all the time, particularly in calculus and its applications.
cues.zh: 聽起來可能很玄、奇怪或超凡，但其實是經常使用的一般函數，尤其在微積分與應用中。

cues.en: And in particular, there's basically just four transcendental functions that we are going to work with
cues.zh: 我們主要會使用四種超越函數，

cues.en: cosine sine, the logarithm and in particular the natural logarithm and the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 餘弦、正弦、對數，尤其自然對數，以及自然指數函數。

cues.en: These are not the only transcendental functions, but these are the ones that are most commonly used, certainly the ones that you will see most often in this course anyway.
cues.zh: 不只這些超越函數，但這些最常用，也肯定是本課最常見的。

cues.en: So that's it for this video.
cues.zh: 這支就到這裡。

cues.en: The main was to introduce and define this term transcendental.
cues.zh: 主要是介紹、定義超越這個名稱。

cues.en: So when you hear me or anyone else talking about transcendental functions, you can simply think of the basic trig functions, the log and the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 所以聽我或其他人說超越函數，可以想到基本三角函數、對數和自然指數函數。

cues.en: Well, you know, that's true in the domain of calculus.
cues.zh: 當然，這是在微積分領域。

cues.en: Outside of discussions of mathematics, you have to infer from context whether is someone is referring
cues.zh: 數學以外，就要根據上下文判斷，對方是指，

cues.en: to, you know, a trig function or some weird metaphysical philosophical state.
cues.zh: 三角函數，還是某種奇怪的形上哲學狀態。
